title: 🎓 Multiple Education Roles Open in York County, Maine - NewsBreak
text:
19 hours ago York County’s higher education scene is buzzing this month, with the University of New England (UNE) hiring for key leadership roles in Biddeford. If you’re passionate about shaping academic programs or guiding future health professionals, these openings are worth a look.
Director of Pre-Health Admissions Employer: University of New England
Location: Biddeford, ME
Type: Full-time
Lead recruitment for UNE’s pre-health programs, from medicine to physical therapy. This role connects directly with academic departments and advising teams to attract and support students pursuing health careers. UNE offers up to 8% retirement match and strong tuition benefits for employees and families.
Associate Provost for Academic Affairs Employer: University of New England
Location: Biddeford, ME
Type: Full-time
A senior leadership position overseeing academic quality, curriculum, and policy across UNE’s undergraduate and graduate programs. Ideal for experienced academic leaders with a doctorate and a record of collaboration and innovation. Comprehensive benefits include multiple health plans, generous leave, and tuition waivers.
